about: Five Strong agents (architect, librarian, teacher, accountant, neighbour) each write about 400 words on a new town library, and a combiner is to join them. The cost cap of the run is only 0.10 USD.
how: The five run side by side. After every answer the run adds up the estimated price from the catalog; when the sum passes the cap, the run stops before the combiner.
learns: A cost cap is a hard stop: the run ends with what was done so far and says so. It protects the budget, but there is no combined report.
watch: The warning near the end that names the cost cap, the status stopped, and the empty final answer.
